rationale: Round-2 duty first — all five of my round-1 asks re-derived against 747bf9b3: (1) R2.4/#245 disposition ADDRESSED. The new 'Delegated dispositions' section records fixed-by-spec-092 with AC-4's ordering pin and AC-14's complete row as regression guards — exactly R2.4's second arm ('or dispositioned fixed-by-spec-092 with the pinning test from R2.1 as the regression guard'). Evidence grade: SUFFICIENT for a plan document. I re-derived the structural claim myself rather than confirming it: complete's RunE has exactly one success return (cmd/mindspec/complete.go:146, reached only after completeTail at :145), completeTail's first statement prints complete.FormatResult, whose first line is 'Bead %s closed.' (internal/complete/complete.go:1380), and TestCompleteTail_NoteIsLastStdoutLine / TestCompleteTail_NoNoteWhileCwdExists exist at cmd/mindspec/cwdsafety_test.go:186/:234 — so a success with zero result lines is structurally unreachable at HEAD. The spec's disposition arm never demanded an end-to-end lifecycle repro; the call-graph derivation plus the real-wiring tests run green exceeds its stated bar, and the offered follow-up e2e is a bonus, not a debt. (2) AC-5(iv) ADDRESSED: the retained warning's recovery line becomes DIRECTION-CONDITIONAL at the emission site derive.go:190-193 (bead 2) — forward disagreements keep 'recovery: mindspec repair phase' (correct there), backward disagreements emit an inspection action ('recovery: bd show <epic-id>'), satisfying the AC's 'an inspection action, never the backward write' letter, with bead 1's guard as backstop. (3) R3.5 ADDRESSED: disposition recorded as TAKEN via bead 3's one-authoritative-derivation recomposition, within the stated no-new-exported-API bar. (4) Bead-10/OQ-1 scope ADDRESSED: the 'Honest scope (round-1 G5.4)' paragraph bounds (a) to the gate-refusal class, the 'entire class' sentence now reads 'entire GATE-REFUSAL class', and bead 10 step 2's merge-safety.md text is explicitly scoped with post-gate failures keeping the 127 preserved-merge/forward-reconcile guidance 'and the doc says so'. (5) OQ-3 wording ADDRESSED: now 'TRUE three-surface agreement' for plan-approve and 'true TWO-surface agreement' for the release plan leg with the tail-less carve-out standing (G5.5 correction). Whole-plan judgment under the lens: the round-1 verified core stands unchanged (option 1 matches settled fact 1 rather than relitigating it; the trigger-2 discharge remains genuine — it depends on stored staying plan absent a lifecycle claim, not on writer counts; the (c)-only vacations and dead option-2 arms are correctly identified; AC-7(i) survives with bead 6 step 6's red-on-revert pin). The fix's new content stays inside the spec's charter: the prospective-snapshot protocol is OQ-1(a)'s required 'answer for how the gates measure yet-uncommitted work', its artifact-exclusion-from-T is consistent with R4.2's own rationale that no gate or panel asserts the tracker projection's content, AC-6/AC-7(i) fixtures survive intact (bead 6 steps 6-7), and the panel-gate-first ordering (complete.go:710-715) is preserved. EnsurePhaseSemanticsV2 (bead 2 step 7) is lock-protected, one-shot under a durable marker, correctly excluded from AC-16's replay path (spec approve is not among its invocation sites), and its v2-unreachability claim is honestly bounded — one minor prose inconsistency it introduces is recorded below. Chunk frontmatter now matches the bead sections (chunk 1 carries the six writer files; chunk 2 the semantics_v2 files; chunk 8's beads.go homed). All 16 ACs remain mapped to scope-capable beads. The residual findings are one-sentence clarifications that do not impeach any AC's deliverability, so APPROVE.

findings.title: NEW_ISSUE (fix-introduced): 'exactly one sanctioned backward writer' is now inconsistent with EnsurePhaseSemanticsV2
findings.detail: The advisory-discharge paragraph still says 'The sanction sentence stays true with exactly one sanctioned backward writer (release's sync)', and the OQ-3 sanction boundary pins phase.SanctionedDerivedSync to one production caller — but bead 2 step 7's EnsurePhaseSemanticsV2 rewrites stored 'implement' to 'plan' on the legacy signature: mechanically an unforced backward write in lifecycle order, performed outside SanctionedDerivedSync. The design is defensible — it is a one-shot SEMANTICS RELABELING (old-implement on a never-claimed epic means v2-plan), gated by a durable marker, lock-protected, and invisible to the operator guard — but the plan should say that in one sentence (e.g. 'the v2 reconciliation is a semantics translation, not a lifecycle move; the sanction sentence refers to lifecycle moves under v2 semantics'), so the writer-inventory reviewer and the AC-5(viii) implementer don't read the reconciliation as a sanction-boundary violation. No mechanical fence is inconsistent (the call-site enumeration and inventory tests remain coherent); this is prose-only, hence minor and non-blocking.
